description: Core implementation of USB Human Interface Device (HID) class handling, including descriptors, request handling, device registration, and event processing.

methods.name: usb_hid_set_proto_code
methods.description: Sets the HID protocol code for a device.

methods.name: usb_hid_init
methods.description: Initializes the HID device, setting report size.

methods.name: usb_hid_register_device
methods.description: Registers a HID device with descriptors and operations.

methods.name: hid_int_ep_write
methods.description: Writes data to the HID interrupt IN endpoint.

methods.name: hid_int_ep_read
methods.description: Reads data from the HID interrupt OUT endpoint.
